notes.title: Introducing Our Next Game, A New Platform Fighter
notes.content: We are proud to announce pre production has begun on our next game, Project Lucario (working title). This game will be a Super Smash Bros platform style fighting game developed on Unreal Engine 5. To find out more, such as our survey later this summer or a chance to playtest, join our discord server.

notes.title: Patch 1.05
notes.content:
* Adds random coin drops for Grass and Cyclops enemy

* Other small fixes

notes.title: Update 1.04
notes.content:
* Fixed inventory issue leftover from previous debugging
*Fixed main menu selection speed with D-pad or arrow keys

notes.title: Update 1.03
notes.content:
* Fixed issue where inventory would not close if using the toggle inventory button. You can not close it with the return button (esc on keyboard, circle on Playstation, B on Xbox)

* Fixed input issue with using items on keyboard. Also, keys are now set to where they can only be used to the corresponding key locks (bronze is for default, gold is to unlock boss area)

* Small fixes to maps and enemy drops

notes.title: First patch
notes.content:
* Fixed a few spelling errors

* Health updates when using a heart container if you are not at full health

* Left click now works with the main menu

notes.title: Blade of the Yokai releases this Friday!
notes.content: Hey everyone, we thought we'd give you guys an update on our launch plans. As you guys may know, Blade of the Yokai launches this Friday around 4:30pm PT, but we'd like to share with you guys that we will be livestreaming our Launch Party on YouTube. The launch party will be an event hosted by two members of Storm Eye Studios as they recap the year long development journey of this game. The game will release at the conclusion of the livestream so we recommend you guys to check it out. Here is the link: [previewyoutube=vnvOKnmRGGI;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]
